items.source: NOTE: This dialect supports custom isolation levels with limitations. Consistent isolation level handling is only guaranteed when all Spring transaction definitions specify a concrete isolation level and when using the default isolation level with non-readOnly and non-lazy transactions; see the "lazyDatabaseTransaction" javadoc for details. Internal locking happens for transaction isolation management in EclipseLink's DatabaseLogin, at the granularity of the EclipseLinkJpaDialect instance; for independent persistence units with different target databases, use distinct EclipseLinkJpaDialect instances in order to minimize the locking impact.
items.translation: 注意：此方言支持具有限制性的自定义隔离级别。 一致的隔离级别处理仅在以下情况下得到保证：所有 Spring 事务定义都指定了具体的隔离级别，并且在使用默认隔离级别与非 readOnly 和非 lazy 事务时；有关详细信息，请参阅 "lazyDatabaseTransaction" javadoc。内部锁定发生在 EclipseLink 的 DatabaseLogin 中，用于管理事务隔离，粒度为 EclipseLinkJpaDialect 实例；对于具有不同目标数据库的独立持久化单元，请使用不同的 EclipseLinkJpaDialect 实例，以最大限度地减少锁定影响。

items.source: By default, this dialect acquires an early EclipseLink transaction with an early JDBC Connection for non-read-only transactions. This allows for mixing JDBC and JPA operations in the same transaction, with cross visibility of their impact. If this is not needed, set the "lazyDatabaseTransaction" flag to true or consistently declare all affected transactions as read-only. This will reliably avoid early JDBC Connection retrieval and therefore keep EclipseLink in shared cache mode.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该方言为非只读事务获取早期的 EclipseLink 事务和早期 JDBC 连接。这允许在同一事务中混合使用 JDBC 和 JPA 操作，并相互可见其影响。如果不需要此功能，请将"lazyDatabaseTransaction"标志设置为true，或始终声明所有受影响的事务为只读。这将可靠地避免获取早期的 JDBC 连接，从而保持 EclipseLink 处于共享缓存模式。

items.source: NOTE: Lazy database transactions are not guaranteed to work reliably in combination with custom isolation levels. Use read-only as well as this lazy flag with care. If other transactions use custom isolation levels, it is not recommended to use read-only and lazy transactions at all. Otherwise, you may see non-default isolation levels used during read-only or lazy access. If this is not acceptable, don't use read-only and lazy next to custom isolation levels in potentially concurrent transactions.
items.translation: 注意：懒数据库事务与自定义隔离级别组合使用时，不能保证可靠运行。请谨慎使用只读模式以及此懒标志。如果其他事务使用了自定义隔离级别，则不建议在任何情况下使用只读和懒事务。否则，在只读或懒访问期间可能会看到非默认的隔离级别。如果这不可接受，请勿在可能存在并发的事务中，将只读和懒事务与自定义隔离级别一起使用。

items.source:
By default, read-only transactions are started lazily but regular
non-read-only transactions are started early. This allows for reusing the
same JDBC Connection throughout an entire EclipseLink transaction, for
enforced isolation and consistent visibility with JDBC access code working
on the same DataSource.
items.translation: 默认情况下，只读事务是懒启动的，而常规非只读事务则提前启动。这允许在整个 EclipseLink 事务中重用同一个 JDBC Connection，从而强制实现隔离性，并确保与在相同 DataSource 上工作的 JDBC 访问代码具有一致的可见性。

items.source:
Switch this flag to "true" to enforce a lazy database transaction begin
even for non-read-only transactions, allowing access to EclipseLink's
shared cache and following EclipseLink's connection mode configuration,
assuming that isolation and visibility at the JDBC level are less important.
items.translation: 将此标志设置为"true"，即使对于非只读事务也强制启用懒式数据库事务开始，从而允许访问 EclipseLink 的共享缓存并遵循 EclipseLink 的连接模式配置，前提是假设 JDBC 级别的隔离性和可见性不那么重要。
